n4ced6cd8da.headline: Higher bio-component in gasoline did not pass, taxation of solar panels and cheaper electricity for railways did | Aktuálně.cz
n4ced6cd8da.summary: Solar power plants commissioned in 2009 and 2010 will now face a solar tax, while taxation of solar panels and electricity costs for railways have been reduced.
n4ced6cd8da.why: Changes in renewable energy taxation affect sector economics and railway operational costs in the Czech Republic.
